observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment claim acquisition, authority eligibility, and registered Git checkout identity

outcome.verified_behavior: Overlapping proposals on the same checkout still conflict. Same-branch overlapping scopes conflict when their observed Git common-directory identities match, and remain conservatively conflicting when identity is absent. Distinct common-directory identities permit separate-clone proposals. Operation scopes lacking identity inherit it only from an exact path match in the current repository observation.
outcome.identity_evidence: Real workspace tests verify that linked worktrees share a Git common-directory identity and a separate clone receives a different identity.
outcome.verification_limit: The policy and identity paths are tested; no live multi-agent conflicting edit or remote integration outcome was exercised.

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

not_measured: remote push or merge conflict outcomes
